style.vernacular: Dense subtropical city of 4-12 storey tile-clad and painted-concrete apartment blocks with window grilles, air-conditioner boxes and rooftop water tanks, often topped by blue or grey corrugated-metal rooftop additions; arcaded shopfront sidewalks (qilou) on older streets; Japanese-era red-brick and stone public buildings; glass towers in Xinyi and the new-town districts; Minnan-style temples with red walls and orange-glazed tile roofs. Camphor and banyan street trees, palms in parks.
style.ornament: Qilou arcades with iron window grilles and hanging signs; rooftop water tanks and blue corrugated sheds; temple swallowtail ridges with dragon and phoenix figures, red lacquered columns and stone lions; Japanese-era red-brick bands with white stone trim; neon vertical signboards.

sources.what: Taiwanese temples by regional style (Minnan, Hakka), red-brick Dutch-era forts, reinforced concrete introduced under Japanese rule
